title: Fragment: Sanguine Initiation
obscured_text: The marks are wet-dark and close together. They refuse to become words.
Only one phrase keeps surfacing: give blood, receive witness.
revealed_text: A novice hand recorded the first rite here. Blood is not paid to a god. It is offered as proof that the body can remember more than fear.
The basin opens only when the wound is honest. The Order calls this the first courtesy of the vein.
